title: Research Pi Codex advisor working synthesis

shared_understanding.description: Only the shared understanding needed for the next decision; omit established background.

points_of_agreement.description: One agreed point per item. Use short sentences and stable terms.

candidate_explanations.description: One explanation per item. State the distinguishing assumption or prediction.

evidence.description: Order by decision value. State one observation and its exact reference per item. Do not copy logs.

uncertainties.description: One material uncertainty per item. Explain how it affects the synthesis.

working_synthesis.description: State the synthesis first. Use short sentences. Include material uncertainty. Refer to evidence instead of duplicating it.
